shared.concept_anchor: Kheda methodological innovations pledge media solidarity

en.display_text:
Consider the following statements about the methodological innovations and dynamics of the Kheda Satyagraha (1918):

1. The Kheda Satyagraha employed a dual-language media strategy — vernacular press for rural mobilization and English press for educated and international audiences — that later became a standard feature of Gandhian campaigns.
2. The pledge-based solidarity mechanism at Kheda — asking the economically secure to join the genuinely distressed in non-payment — was a solution to the collective action problem of sustaining non-compliance under economic pressure.
3. The failure of British distraint tactics at Kheda — through asset concealment and auction refusal by neighbors — demonstrated that coercive enforcement of revenue demands was legally impossible under existing colonial law.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?

(a) 1 and 2 only
(b) 2 and 3 only
(c) 1 and 3 only
(d) 1, 2 and 3

statement_analysis.statement: The Kheda Satyagraha employed a dual-language media strategy — vernacular press for rural mobilization and English press for educated and international audiences — that later became a standard feature of Gandhian campaigns.
statement_analysis.reason: Gandhi's use of Navajivan (Gujarati) alongside Young India (English) at Kheda was a deliberate dual-track media strategy, adapted to the distinct literacy levels and audiences of rural Gujarat vs. the educated English-reading public — this model was subsequently replicated.

statement_analysis.statement: The pledge-based solidarity mechanism at Kheda — asking the economically secure to join the genuinely distressed in non-payment — was a solution to the collective action problem of sustaining non-compliance under economic pressure.
statement_analysis.reason: By creating a moral pledge (rather than relying on individual calculation of economic benefit), Gandhi generated social and moral costs for defection, sustaining collective non-compliance even when individual households might have benefited from paying and avoiding asset attachment.

statement_analysis.statement: The failure of British distraint tactics at Kheda — through asset concealment and auction refusal by neighbors — demonstrated that coercive enforcement of revenue demands was legally impossible under existing colonial law.
statement_analysis.reason: Distraint was legally permissible under colonial revenue law — the failure was not legal but social and practical. Peasants' asset concealment and neighbors' auction refusal were acts of social solidarity that made enforcement practically impossible, not legally impermissible.

en.strong_distractor: d — Option (d) — all three — tempts students who find all three statements superficially plausible, particularly Statement 3's claim about 'legal impossibility' which sounds like it could refer to the one-fourth threshold rule.
elimination_logic: Verify Statement 1: Dual-language media strategy (Navajivan + Young India) is documented at Kheda — correct.
Verify Statement 2: Pledge mechanism solving the collective action defection problem is analytically accurate and historically documented — correct.
Verify Statement 3: The failure of distraint was social/practical, not legal — distraint was legally valid under colonial revenue law. 'Legally impossible' is factually wrong. Mark incorrect.
Statements 1 and 2 correct — option (a).
en.upsc_trap_explanation: Statement 3's trap is the phrase 'legally impossible under existing colonial law' — students who know the one-fourth threshold rule may think this legal provision made the entire distraint legally invalid. But the one-fourth rule addressed remission entitlement, not the legality of distraint itself. Distraint was legally authorized; it was socially neutralized by community solidarity. Confusing legal invalidity with practical ineffectiveness is the precise error Statement 3 engineers.
en.final_explanation:
The Kheda Satyagraha pioneered three distinct methodological innovations, each of which became part of the standard Gandhian toolkit.

• Statement 1 — Correct: The Navajivan (Gujarati) + Young India (English) dual-track media strategy was a Kheda innovation — different content, different language, different audiences, coordinated for maximum impact. It became the template for media management in subsequent national movements.
• Statement 2 — Correct: The pledge mechanism — asking solvent peasants to join the genuinely distressed in non-payment — addressed the fundamental collective action problem: individual rational calculation would favor paying (to avoid asset loss), undermining collective non-compliance. The pledge created moral costs for defection that overrode individual economic calculation.
• Statement 3 — Incorrect: The failure of distraint was practical and social, not legal. Colonial revenue law fully authorized attachment and auction of peasants' assets for non-payment. What made it fail was community solidarity — concealment of assets and auction refusal by neighbors — rendering the legally authorized mechanism socially and practically inoperative.

Value Addition:
• The distinction 'legally authorized but socially neutralized' is analytically important — it shows how civil society action can disable state coercive machinery without challenging its legal basis.
• Both successful innovations (dual media + pledge solidarity) were directly replicated in the Non-Cooperation Movement (1920) and Civil Disobedience (1930).
• Kheda's methodological significance may exceed its material outcome — it was a laboratory that changed how Gandhi organized resistance.

hi.display_text:
खेडा सत्याग्रह (1918) की कार्यप्रणालीगत नवाचारों और गतिशीलता के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. खेड़ा सत्याग्रह ने द्विभाषी मीडिया रणनीति अपनाई — ग्रामीण जनसंचालन के लिए स्थानीय भाषा का प्रेस और शिक्षित तथा अंतरराष्ट्रीय दर्शकों के लिए अंग्रेज़ी प्रेस — जो बाद में गांधीवादी अभियानों की एक मानक विशेषता बन गई।
2. खेड़ा में प्रतिज्ञा-आधारित एकजुटता तंत्र — आर्थिक रूप से सक्षम लोगों से वास्तविक रूप से पीड़ितों के साथ गैर-भुगतान में शामिल होने का आग्रह — आर्थिक दबाव के तहत असहयोग बनाए रखने की सामूहिक क्रिया समस्या का समाधान था।
3. खेड़ा में ब्रिटिश जब्ती रणनीतियों की विफलता — संपत्ति छुपाने और पड़ोसियों द्वारा नीलामी से इनकार के माध्यम से — यह दर्शाती है कि राजस्व मांगों के जबरन प्रवर्तन को मौजूदा औपनिवेशिक कानून के तहत कानूनी रूप से असंभव था।

उपरोक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

(a) केवल 1 और 2
(b) केवल 2 और 3
(c) केवल 1 और 3
(d) 1, 2 और 3
